_comment: Per-project phase gate. tests and acs are REQUIRED. This is the real gate: a phase with a red suite or unticked criteria does not pass. The tests check runs the project's own test command from .claude/builder-kit.json (jiffi-init writes it per type: web npm test, ios xcodebuild test, agent npm run eval), falling back to npm test if that config is absent, so a green checkpoint means the REAL suite passed on every target. If your very first phase has no tests yet, that failure is correct (write them). Tighten further per phase in docs/checkpoints/phase-<n>.json.

checks.label: Phase committed and pushed
checks.note: confirm the phase branch is committed and pushed
